title: Crust of Rust: Lifetime Annotations
summary: In this first Crust of Rust episode, Jon Gjengset live-codes an example that needs multiple explicit lifetime annotations. Along the way he covers string types and generics over a custom trait.
why: Recommended as a slow-paced, detailed live-coding session that makes lifetimes click once you are past Rust basics.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: each one is actually writing carefully chosen code that runs and talking through what's going on
